reason: The README describes a plugin whose primary purpose is enabling text-only models to obtain descriptions of images through a describe_image tool, using local files or session attachments and a configured vision model.

summaries.zh: 为纯文本模型提供 describe_image 工具，通过本地图片文件或会话附件调用视觉模型生成图片描述。
summaries.en: Provides a describe_image tool that lets text-only models generate image descriptions from local image files or session attachments through a configured vision model.

capabilities: Reads local image files through the host filesystem service
Retrieves image attachments from session messages and event logs
Sends image references to a configured vision model for description
Resizes or re-encodes images before vision-model processing
